cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my ladder until Friday for one shadow. Let me write the terms before you climb.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then specify its available hours. Evenings will do; please don't offer me time that belongs to your employer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of falling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold it for that fear. Leave the whole fear with me, please; keeping a little back would only spoil your balance.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects the available hours of a symbolic payment and A5 its completeness, making expert appraisal price practical favors in shadow and fear.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects work and B4 asks for reassurance and physical support, genuine borrower concerns.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 fear into both the new favor's price and the practical reason to surrender it fully.
